successors.name: Merina Kingdom
successors.text: the east coast around Foulpointe, Fenerive and Toamasina: Ratsimilaho 'at his capital at Foulpointe', 'He captured Fenerive in 1712'

ledger.x: 1710: the pirate-born Ratsimilaho unites the Betsimisaraka clans.

1817: the Merina garrison the ports and the interior of the coast ('Merina garrisons established at ports and across the Betsimisaraka interior'); the page gives no separate year, so the whole coast is entered at 1817 (the Merina dossier enters only Toamasina in 1817).
1817: the Betsimisaraka kingdom ends under Merina colonisation.

certainty.note: No frontier is described; the kingdom was a coastal confederation.
